Hyper Duel.name: Hyper Duel
Hyper Duel.summary: Hyper Duel is an Action game, developed and published by TechnoSoft, which was released in Japan in 1996.

Rockman X3.name: Mega Man X3
Rockman X3.summary: The PlayStation/Sega Saturn port of Mega Man X3 adds a new soundtrack in CD-quality and cutscenes in FMV.

Yuukyuu Gensoukyoku Ensemble 2.name: Yuukyuu Gensoukyoku Ensemble 2
Yuukyuu Gensoukyoku Ensemble 2.summary: Yuukyuu Gensoukyoku ensemble 2 is a fan disc for the Sega Saturn and Playstation. It contains bonus content for fans of Yuukyuu Gensoukyoku 2nd Album, including epilogues for several characters, unreleased and cut storylines, and an art gallery.
